	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	st2 := acceptWithTimeout(t, s2)

	// Stream for a blocked writer.', '	st1, err := s1.OpenStream(MuxPriorityNormal)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	_ = st1
	st2 := acceptWithTimeout(t, s2)

	// Stream for a blocked writer.')
s=s.replace('	w2 := acceptWithTimeout(t, s2)

	readDone', '	w2 := acceptWithTimeout(t, s2)
	_ = w2

	readDone')
open(path,'w').write(s)
